_comment: Maps business types to their most relevant document templates. Used during Zero to Branded setup to pre-select and surface the right template subset for the user's business.

business_types.label: Creative / Marketing Agency
business_types.description: Design, branding, marketing, advertising, or PR agencies
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Client Proposal for your next pitch

business_types.label: Consultancy / Advisory
business_types.description: Strategy, management, finance, HR, legal, or specialist consultancies
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Consulting Proposal for a new engagement

business_types.label: Tech Startup / SaaS
business_types.description: Software companies, SaaS products, apps, developer tools, or early-stage tech businesses
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Pitch Deck for investors or partners

business_types.label: Freelancer / Independent Contractor
business_types.description: Solo practitioners — developers, writers, photographers, videographers, coaches, trainers
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Project Proposal for a new client

business_types.label: Professional Services
business_types.description: Law firms, accounting firms, financial advisors, architects, engineers, surveyors
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Services Proposal for a new client engagement

business_types.label: Product Company
business_types.description: Companies that build and sell physical or digital products — hardware, e-commerce, manufacturing
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Sales Deck for your product

business_types.label: Internal Team / Department
business_types.description: An internal team, division, or department using doc-factory for internal communications and operations
business_types.first_doc_prompt: Create a Project Status Update for your team

business_types.label: General / Other
business_types.description: Fallback for businesses that don't clearly match another type

inference_rules: If multiple types match, prefer the one with more keyword matches
If no keywords match, use 'general' as the fallback
Never ask the user to pick a business type explicitly — infer it from the conversation
